key_results: AMFA-SVM achieves 93.2% accuracy, 98.0% recall, 88.9% F1-score on INbreast dataset; adaptive weighting of PCA, UMAP, t-SNE representations enhances discrimination
comments: Multi-manifold aggregation is interpretable but computational overhead of three feature-space projections may limit deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive aggregation of complementary manifold representations improves lesion classification over single-feature approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AMFA-SVM outperforms baselines with balanced precision-recall trade-off

title: Identifying and profiling high-risk social media information in higher education: a multidimensional risk assessment approach
task: High-risk social media information identification and profiling in higher education
key_results: Entropy-weighted composite risk scores stratified into four levels; four information profiles identified via K-Modes clustering (low-reach emotional, high-reach neutral long-form, high-reach negative amplification, low-reach neutral residual); Pearson correlation −0.87 between confidence metric and fitting errors
comments: Multidimensional risk framework is interpretable for governance but event-specific thresholds limit generalization across different university-related topics.

inputs: 14,911 Weibo posts (source attributes, content characteristics, dissemination patterns)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multidimensional risk metrics better predict human judgments than single-factor indicators
hypotheses.result: Supported; confidence metric correlates strongly with actual fitting errors (−0.87)

title: Improving UAV-based air quality measurements through machine learning calibration of downwash effects
task: UAV air quality measurement calibration using machine learning to correct downwash effects
key_results: Tree-based ensemble algorithm achieves lowest NO₂ error (comparable to inter-sensor variability); PM₂.₅ requires no additional calibration; nine algorithms evaluated with meteorological/seasonal integration
comments: Downwash effect is pollutant-dependent; ML calibration is practical for gaseous pollutants but unnecessary for particulates.

model_io.model: Tree-based ensemble (gradient boosting) + alternative algorithms (9 tested)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ML-based calibration reduces downwash-induced NO₂ error to inter-sensor variability levels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tree-based ensemble outperforms other algorithms; PM₂.₅ shows inherent robustness

title: Analysis of solar collector efficiency utilizing micro-groove channels, swirled ribbon, and square coil improvements: a numerical and experimental study
task: Solar collector efficiency analysis with micro-groove, swirled ribbon, and square coil using CFD and experiments
key_results: Micro-groove + swirled ribbon + square coil design achieves thermal-hydraulic factor of 1.2; electrical efficiency improved 37.91% with 0.2% Al₂O₃ nanofluid; PV cell temperature decreased 32.04°C; power output 24.2 W
comments: Experimental validation of CFD predictions; nanofluid concentration and flow optimization are key efficiency drivers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Swirled ribbon and square coil enhance heat transfer; nanofluid improves thermal conductivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 37.91% electrical-efficiency improvement with 0.2% nanofluid and optimized flow

title: PLM driven digital twin manufacturing through EBOM to MBOM transformation in railway industry
task: PLM-driven digital twin manufacturing via EBOM-to-MBOM transformation in railway industry
key_results: Five-layer reference architecture identified from cross-case analysis; governed BOM transformation and manufacturing-specific item types enable digital thread integrity
comments: Qualitative case study with limited quantitative metrics; transferability to non-rail discrete manufacturing unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Governed EBOM-to-MBOM transformation prerequisites digital thread integrity in complex manufacturing
hypotheses.result: Supported by case documentation and practitioner knowledge from three organizations

title: Efficient simulation of 3D gravity fields and gradient tensors using gauss–FFT for complex terrain
task: Efficient 3D gravity field and gradient-tensor simulation using Gauss-FFT for complex terrain
key_results: Space-wavenumber mixed-domain method reduces computational complexity and memory; Gauss-FFT suppresses boundary truncation; accuracy comparable to analytical solutions
comments: Fast algorithm leverages 2D FFT with vertical integration; terrain discretization strategy balances accuracy and efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Space-wavenumber decomposition accelerates 3D gravity forward modeling without sacrificing accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; method achieves analytical-solution accuracy with significantly reduced runtime

title: Advanced visualization technologies in enhancing student learning and performance in K-12 STEM education
task: Narrative review of advanced visualization technologies in K-12 STEM education
key_results: Five categories identified: multisensory products, creative tools, AI-adaptive platforms, extended reality, and scientific-data visualization; positive effects on conceptual understanding, reasoning, and 21st-century skills
comments: Literature review without novel experimental validation; recommendations are pedagogically motivated but lack quantified impact metrics.

title: Free-space and on-chip diffractive deep neural network for next-generation optical computing
task: Review of diffractive deep neural networks for optical computing
key_results: D2NNs achieve zero-power consumption, ultrafast processing, and intrinsic optical parallelism for classification and 3D perception tasks
comments: Conceptual review; no novel empirical results or quantitative comparisons provided.

title: Uni-Map: unified camera-LiDAR perception for robust HD map construction
task: Unified camera-LiDAR HD map construction for autonomous driving
key_results: Uni-Map outperforms state-of-the-art across normal and 13 sensor-corruption scenarios; single model handles camera-only, LiDAR-only, and fusion configurations
comments: Mixture stack training and latent-space alignment enable graceful degradation under missing or corrupted modalities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modality-agnostic feature alignment improves robustness to sensor degradation
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated superior performance under corruption scenarios vs. prior methods

title: A new platform for achieving long-term air-stable long persistent luminescence in amorphous organic system
task: Air-stable long persistent luminescence in amorphous organic systems via phosphorescence donor-acceptor platforms
key_results: Achieved hour-level air-stable OLPL (1.6–7154.3 s tunable duration); emission colors controlled 500–680 nm via guest concentration; rare circularly polarized OLPL (CP-OLPL) demonstrated with chiral dopants
comments: Novel amorphous platform addresses prior challenge of air stability; tunable persistent time over three orders of magnitude and rare CP-OLPL open applications in security inks and bioimaging.

outputs: Circular dichroism and circularly polarized luminescence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Achieving hour-level air-stable OLPL in organic systems is not feasible
hypotheses.result: Refuted; amorphous donor-acceptor platform achieves up to 7154.3 s persistent luminescence in air

title: On-chip terahertz metasensor for quantitative multi-component biomolecular identification
task: On-chip THz metasensor for multi-component biomolecular quantification
key_results: Compact 4 mm×8 mm lithium niobate metasensor identifies and quantifies mixtures of four biomolecules with <3.60% error; five-order-of-magnitude size reduction vs. conventional THz-TDS systems
comments: Demonstrates both identification and quantification of multi-component samples on a single chip—major advance over prior qualitative single-molecule detection platforms.

model_io.model: On-chip THz metasensor on lithium niobate (20 μm thickness)

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-chip THz sensors can only qualitatively detect single molecule types
hypotheses.result: Refuted; integrated metasurface enables quantitative multi-component analysis with high accuracy

title: Gate-imprinted memory and light-induced erasure of superconductivity at KTaO3-based interfaces
task: Non-volatile superconductivity control via gate and light
key_results: Demonstrated gate-imprinted memory enhancing superconductivity and cryogenic optical erasure via polar-nanoregion reorientation and oxygen vacancy dynamics
comments: Novel coupling of superconductivity with emergent lattice excitations enables memory encoding, a promising direction for quantum information technologies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gate cycling and optical effects act independently on superconductivity
hypotheses.result: Refuted; coupled effects from polar-nanoregions and charge trapping underlie both phenomena

title: Krypton-sputtered tantalum films for scalable high-performance quantum devices
task: Krypton-sputtered tantalum films for superconducting quantum devices
key_results: Krypton sputtering enables bcc tantalum at 200 °C (vs. >400 °C for argon); tight resonator performance distribution; transmon qubits achieve quality factors up to 16.9 million with 20 μm capacitor gaps
comments: Low-temperature synthesis via gas-switching provides back-end-of-line compatibility and excellent qubit performance, addressing major manufacturing bottleneck for Ta-based quantum processors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Krypton and argon sputtering yield equivalent tantalum films
hypotheses.result: Refuted; krypton promotes bcc phase at much lower temperature with superior qubit performance

title: Irreversibility and symmetry breaking in the creation and annihilation of defects in active living matter
task: Mirror-symmetry breaking in defect creation/annihilation in active living matter
key_results: Half-integer defects created/annihilated with spontaneous mirror-symmetry breaking in bacteria and epithelial cells; entropy production reveals asymmetry between creation and annihilation processes
comments: Reveals dualism between nematic organization and polar forces; challenges conventional active nematic models by demonstrating entropy-driven asymmetry unique to biological systems.

inputs: Swarming bacteria and bronchial epithelial cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Defect creation and annihilation are time-reversed processes
hypotheses.result: Refuted; entropy production reveals irreversibility with spontaneous mirror-symmetry breaking

title: Photo-induced interfacial charge transfer in solar-responsive PVDF composite membranes
task: Photoinduced charge transfer in PVDF/BN/WN composite membranes for solar-driven distillation
key_results: Band gap narrowing from 5.41 eV (pristine PVDF) to 0.57 eV in composite; low-energy optical absorption ~0.85 eV from charge-transfer transitions; MD confirms structural stability
comments: Multiscale DFT-to-MD framework quantifies interfacial charge transfer and photothermal response, establishing design principles for efficient solar membrane applications.

inputs: Hexagonal BN and tungsten nitride nanofillers
outputs: Band structure and density of states

hypotheses.hypothesis: PVDF remains wide-gap insulator upon nanofiller incorporation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; orbital hybridization drives 9.5× band gap reduction to 0.57 eV

title: Modeling of seismic attenuation and anisotropy in fractured media: an integrated VSP study
task: Integrated VSP workflow for fracture-induced anisotropy and seismic attenuation in reservoirs
key_results: Azimuthal velocity variation correlates with fracture orientation; quality factor varies from ~82 (fracture-parallel) to ~100 (fracture-normal) in reservoir (2800–3200 m); close agreement with FMI-derived fracture geometry
comments: Establishes quantitative link between fracture orientation and azimuthal attenuation; HTI viscoelastic modeling provides robust fracture characterization tool for naturally fractured carbonates.

model_io.model: Layer-stripping tomographic inversion on VSP data
outputs: Layer-specific anisotropic P- and S-wave velocities

model_io.model: Horizontally transverse isotropic (HTI) viscoelastic rock-physics model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Seismic attenuation is independent of fracture orientation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; systematic azimuthal Q variation (82–100) reflects fluid-flow-induced attenuation in compliant fractures

title: Wave propagation in a photo-thermomechanical medium with triple porosity and voids under the Lord–Shulman theory
task: Wave propagation in photo-thermoelastic porous media with triple porosity, voids, and carrier density coupling
key_results: Carrier density introduces new plasma wave slow diffusion mode; significantly alters stress concentration and enhances energy dissipation vs. triple porosity alone; quality factor varies 82–100 in porous silicon with thermal/plasma relaxation times controlling attenuation
comments: Extends classical poroelasticity to coupled photo-thermal-mechanical system with three pore scales; rigorous analytical solution reveals plasma wave as novel dissipation mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photo-thermal effects marginally perturb triple porosity wave propagation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; carrier density introduces new plasma wave mode with significant impact on stress and energy dissipation

title: Nudge-driven cooperation emerges through adaptive learning in evolutionary games
task: Interplay of nudge design, learning mechanisms, and cooperation in evolutionary games
key_results: State-dependent nudges produce threshold effects with rapid amplification; time-decaying nudges create path dependence; reinforcement learning smooths transitions and stabilizes metastable states versus imitation dynamics
comments: Reveals that behavioral effectiveness is not generalizable: constant nudges shift phase boundaries linearly, but state-dependent nudges exhibit nonlinear amplification—design matters.

hypotheses.hypothesis: All nudge types produce equivalent cooperation promotion with different magnitudes
hypotheses.result: Refuted; qualitatively distinct outcomes including threshold effects and path dependence

title: Saturable absorption in NV-doped diamond studied by femtosecond Z-scan
task: Saturable absorption mechanism in NV-doped diamond via femtosecond Z-scan
key_results: NV-doped samples exhibit saturable absorption at 1032 nm; H2 defects dominate saturable response with linear absorption coefficient and saturation intensity extracted; off-resonant NV contribution weaker
comments: Demonstrates importance of defect environment complexity; effective two-level analysis clarifies that vibronic transitions (not zero-phonon lines) drive observed nonlinearity.

inputs: Diamond crystals with varying NV/N concentrations

hypotheses.hypothesis: NV centers dominate saturable absorption in NV-doped diamond
hypotheses.result: Disproven; H2 (NVN−) defects are primary contributor; NV contribution off-resonant and weaker

title: Chaos and dynamic instabilities of FGM micro-pipes with internal fluid flow via strain gradient theory
task: Chaos and dynamic instability in fluid-conveying FGM micropipes with strain gradient effects
key_results: Critical power-law index threshold n≈42 for chaos emergence in FGM; counterintuitive stabilization when dimensionless microscale parameter δ>0.027 suppresses chaotic vibrations; sixth-order nonlinear coupled system solved numerically
comments: First quantitative definition of chaos threshold via material composition; demonstrates dual control via both power-law index and microstructural size—enabling active tuning inaccessible to single-parameter theories.

inputs: Functionally graded material composition (power-law index n)
Strain gradient parameters (three independent length scales)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger strain gradient parameter always increases dynamic stability
hypotheses.result: Partially refuted; stabilization occurs at δ>0.027, but smaller values can destabilize; non-monotonic relationship

hypotheses.hypothesis: Classical elasticity captures FGM micropipe chaos adequately
hypotheses.result: Refuted; gradient theory with three independent length scales essential to predict chaos threshold and stabilization mechanism

title: DFT exploration of solvation and lone pair effects on the second harmonic generation of circular π-conjugated macrocycles
task: Second harmonic generation in π-conjugated macrocycles via DFT design
key_results: AZ-Se1 achieves highest first hyperpolarizability βtot=66,947.17 a.u.; band gap range 0.97–2.79 eV; frequency-dependent γ up to 1.4×10⁹ a.u. at 1907 nm
comments: Comprehensive multifunctional design combining SHG, light harvesting (LHE up to 0.99), and long radiative lifetime (40.82 ns) in a single platform.

inputs: Four series of dibenzothiophene cyclic molecules

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger heterocycle (Se) enhances SHG over smaller atoms (S, O, N)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AZ-Se1 shows 2× higher βtot than closest S/O analogues

title: Investigating the yellow exciton series of Cu2O at ultrahigh magnetic fields
task: Exciton behavior in Cu2O under ultrahigh magnetic fields
key_results: Resolved 2p0 and 3p0 exciton state assignments; measured exciton reduced effective mass 0.415±0.01me; observed non-parabolic valence band effects above 300 T deviating from hydrogen model
comments: High-field data reveals band mixing effects previously inaccessible, providing quantitative evidence for limitations of the standard hydrogen model in semiconductors.

inputs: Pulsed magnetic fields up to 500 T

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exciton wavefunction shrinkage follows hydrogen model across all fields
hypotheses.result: Disproven above 300 T; non-parabolic effects dominate due to valence band/split-off band mixing

title: Machine-learning-based model for predicting surface impedance of microslit panels in grazing flow
task: Machine learning prediction of microslit panel surface impedance under grazing flow
key_results: Backpropagation neural network combined with classical formulas enables rapid surface impedance prediction; model captures flow-acoustic coupling effects; validated experimentally
comments: Hybrid approach (classical theory + neural network correction) provides physically interpretable predictions while overcoming nonlinear flow limitations of classical models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Classical microslit panel models predict accurate impedance under grazing flow
hypotheses.result: Refuted; nonlinear flow-acoustic interactions require neural network correction
